question: Following urinary catheterisation of a postpartum woman, the nurse notes 800 mL of urine drains in the first 30 minutes and the catheter is now draining only a few drops. What is the MOST likely explanation and appropriate next step?

answers.text: The catheter is correctly placed; large initial drainage after labour is expected and needs no action

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: While initial large drainage after obstructed or prolonged labour is expected, suddenly stopping drainage requires assessment — the catheter may be kinked or the bladder may need re-evaluation.

answers.text: The catheter balloon may have migrated into the urethra; deflate and re-advance it into the bladder

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Balloon migration into the urethra is not the most common cause of sudden reduced drainage after initial good flow. Kinking or the catheter tip abutting the bladder wall is more likely.

answers.text: Check for catheter kinking in the tubing or sheet; also check that the drainage bag is below the level of the bladder

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Correct. Sudden reduction in drainage after adequate initial flow is most commonly caused by mechanical obstruction — a kinked catheter tube or a drainage bag placed above the bladder level preventing gravity drainage.

answers.text: Immediately irrigate the catheter with 50 mL of normal saline to clear a mucus plug

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Bladder irrigation is not the first step. Before any intervention, check for simple mechanical causes (kinking, bag position) which are by far the most common and require no invasive action.

overallFeedback.feedback: When drainage suddenly stops after an initial good flow, the most common cause is mechanical: a kinked tube, a bag above the level of the bladder, or the catheter tip against the bladder wall. Always check the simple causes before intervening.
Well done. Mechanical causes — tube kinking and drainage bag position — should be checked first whenever urinary output suddenly drops after initial good catheter drainage.
